title: Apple Podcasts names Baby, this is Keke Palmer the 2026 Show of the Year
summary: Apple Podcasts names Baby, this is Keke Palmer as its 2026 Show of the Year, honoring the podcast for its exceptional quality and cultural impact.
body_markdown:
Text of this article


November 17, 2026


UPDATE


Apple Podcasts names :br(xl)::br(l): *Baby, this is Keke Palmer* :br(xl)::br(l):the 2026 Show of the Year


Hosted by Keke Palmer and produced by Wondery, the podcast brings infectious humor and genuine curiosity to conversations with today’s biggest cultural voices


Today, Apple Podcasts named[Baby, this is Keke Palmer](https://apple.co/soty-26) its Show of the Year, honoring the podcast for its exceptional quality and cultural impact. Hosted by award-winning multi-hyphenate entertainer Keke Palmer and produced by Wondery and executive produced by Palmer, the show pairs her quick wit with genuine curiosity, striking a balance between humor and thoughtful inquiry that makes even the most recognizable guests feel like close friends. Her natural ability to connect with people draws audiences into every conversation, while her candor and energy bring a refreshing and unique authenticity to the interview format.


Palmer invites some of the biggest names in entertainment and culture to share the experiences that have shaped them. From exploring self-worth with Oprah Winfrey to discussing creativity, reinvention, and fatherhood with Anderson .Paak, she moves effortlessly between laugh-out-loud exchanges and thoughtful reflections on life, relationships, and success. *Baby, this is Keke Palmer* consistently ranks among the top video and top comedy shows on Apple Podcasts.


“I’m so honored that *Baby, this is Keke Palmer* has been named Apple Podcasts’ Show of the Year,” said Palmer. “I love how a conversation about entertainment can open up a bigger conversation about life. There’s so much to explore in the things we watch, laugh at, and connect with, and this show gives me room to follow that curiosity. Thank you to Apple Podcasts, Wondery, our incredible guests, and everyone who listens and brings their own perspective to the conversation. This recognition means so much to me.”


“Keke’s curiosity, humor, and openness make every conversation feel personal, and video brings that connection even closer,” said Oliver Schusser, Apple’s vice president of Podcasts, Music, Sports, and Beats. “Her exceptional craft and cultural impact make *Baby, this is Keke Palmer* Apple Podcasts’ Show of the Year. We’re proud to celebrate her talent across Apple Podcasts and Apple Music, from the conversations she creates to the music she shares.”


**Inside Show of the Year**


For Palmer, podcasting starts with connection. In an interview with Apple Podcasts for Creators, excerpted below, the host of *Baby, this is Keke Palmer* shares why she creates room for honest conversation, trusts her curiosity and authenticity, and celebrates being named the Apple Podcasts 2026 Show of the Year.


**On creating space for connection** : “I’ve spent so much of my life being seen, but being seen and being known are two very different things. … I love that I get to create a space where people can just be people, myself included.”


**On following her curiosity** : “Preparation is supposed to support the conversation, not control it. I’m always listening for that moment when somebody says something that opens up an entirely new question.”


**On bringing authenticity to video** : “Don’t try to manufacture a personality for the camera. Develop a relationship with yourself, get comfortable expressing what is already there, and let the camera capture that.”


**On being named the Apple Podcasts Show of the Year** : “What makes me most proud is that something rooted in genuine curiosity and connection has resonated with other people. It reminds me that being yourself isn’t just personally fulfilling; it can also create value for others. And that’s always been the goal for me.”
